segments.name: CECONY
segments.description: Regulated utility that delivers electricity, gas and steam to customers in New York City and Westchester County.
segments.evidence: Con Edison's principal business segments are CECONY's regulated utility activities, O&R's regulated utility activities and Con Edison Transmission.

segments.name: O&R
segments.description: Regulated utility providing electric service in southeastern New York and northern New Jersey and gas service in southeastern New York.
segments.evidence: O&R and its utility subsidiary, Rockland Electric Company (RECO) (together referred to herein as O&R) provide electric service to approximately 0.3 million customers in southeastern New York and northern New Jersey, an approximately 1,300 square mile service area.

segments.name: Con Edison Transmission
segments.description: Develops and invests in electric transmission projects and owns electric and gas assets through joint ventures.
segments.evidence: Con Edison Transmission, through its subsidiaries, develops and invests in electric transmission projects and owns, through joint ventures, both electric and gas assets.

revenueModel.text: The Utilities charge full-service customers for the energy they supply and all customers for delivery service, under tariffs approved by state regulators.
revenueModel.evidence: The Utilities recover from their full-service customers (who purchase energy from them), generally on a current basis, the cost the Utilities pay for energy and charge all of their customers the cost of delivery service.

changes.text: In 2023 Con Edison completed the sale of the Clean Energy Businesses, which ceased to be a principal segment.
changes.evidence: On March 1, 2023, Con Edison completed the sale of all of the stock of the Clean Energy Businesses.
